title: Elbląg city office warns schools of Facebook profile asking students to send network-trace screenshots
date_note: The page gives only its own publication day; the warning was published that day.
summary: Elblag24 reports that the city office's Department of Innovation and IT, whose director is Jacek Boruszka, issued an urgent warning about a Facebook profile called "Ognisty Phoenix". The profile reportedly asks students to run tracert ipinfo.io and curl ipinfo.io on school computers and send screenshots. Officials say the results could reveal a school's public IP address and network details.
plain: A Facebook profile is asking Elbląg students to run network commands and send screenshots. City officials warn this could reveal school network details.
exec: According to Elblag24, city officials say collecting such data from many schools could map the city's network before an attack.
action: The department advises telling students not to run the commands, send screenshots or contact the profile, informing parents, reporting any confirmed incident to the department, and reporting the profile to Facebook.
impact: Warning only; the page gives no number of students or schools contacted.

validation.note: Single publisher (elblag24.pl) relaying the city department's warning; the city's own page was not read.

review.note: Compared department, profile name, commands, risk statement, advice and date against Elblag24
